items.stem: In Business Central AL, which object type is best when you must join and aggregate data efficiently?

options.rationale: Correct: query objects join and aggregate data efficiently in AL.
A record variable loop is slower for joined aggregation.
An XMLport handles import/export of structured data, not aggregation.
A permission set controls access, not data retrieval.

items.stem: Select TWO tasks involved in integrating Business Central with external applications.

options.text: Call a REST service using HttpClient and JSON
options.rationale: Correct: HttpClient with JSON consumes external REST services.

options.rationale: Correct: API pages with bound actions expose Business Central data.
